en: dance – to dance with smb
She danced with her partner at the ball.
ru: Она танцевала со своим партнером на балу.

en: He danced with his sister at the party.
ru: Он танцевал со своей сестрой на вечеринке.

en: decide – to decide to do smth
She decided to join the club.

She decided the question after discussion.
He decided the problem with his team.
ru: Он решил проблему со своей командой.

She decorated the room for the party.

She defended herself from the attacker.

She denied the possibility of failure.

He destroyed the paper in anger.

ru: Она установила значение слова с помощью словаря.

ru: Она определила его возраст по внешности.

He discovered a mistake in his calculations.
ru: Он обнаружил ошибку в своих расчетах.

She doubted her friend’s words.
He doubted his colleague’s words.
draw – to draw a breath

He drew a breath to calm down.

draw – to draw in

draw – to draw up
